Title: Successful login
Steps: Open login page → Enter valid email & password → Click Sign in
Expected Result: Redirect to dashboard, 200 response, session cookie created

Title: Empty fields validation
Steps: Open login page → Leave fields empty → Click Sign in
Expected Result: Validation error shown(required), no network call

Title: Invalid password
Steps: Enter valid email and wrong password → Click Sign in
Expected Result: Error message 'Incorrect email or password', 422 response

Title: Non-existing user
Steps: Enter non-existing email and any password → Sign in
Expected Result: Generic error message shown(Entered value does not match email format)

Title: Invalid email format
Steps: Enter 'abc' and any password → Sign in
Expected Result: "Entered value does not match email format"

Title: Empty password
Steps: Enter valid email and leave password empty → Sign in
Expected Result: Validation error shown(required), no network call

Title: Email with spaces
Steps: Enter ' user@example.com ' and valid password → Sign in

Title: Very long password
Steps: Enter valid email and 300-char password → Sign in
Expected Result: Error message 'Incorrect email or password', 422 response

Title: Enter key submits form
Expected Result: Form submitted successfully, successful login, Redirect to dashboard, 200 response, session cookie created

Title: Forgot password link
Expected Result: Redirect to password reset page, after entering password "Check your email" and get back to Sign in

Title: Rate limiting
Steps: Try 10 failed logins in a row
Expected Result: Error message 'Incorrect email or password', 422 response

Title: Eye icon toggle password
Steps: Click eye icon in password field

Title: Sign up with existing user email
Steps: Open sign up page  → Enter email of existing user → Click send code
Expected Result: Error pop up, "This email address is already registered. Please use a different email or try logging in."

Title: Sign up with new email
Steps: Open sign up page  → Enter new email → Click send code
Expected Result: 6 digit code is sent to email, resend code in 60 sec, successful login with 6 digit code
